---
title: "Visualizations"
format:
  html:
    include-after-body:
      text: |
        <script src="visualizations.js"></script>
---

```{=html}
<div class="visualization-page">

  <div id="visualization-gallery" class="visualization-gallery"></div>

  <div id="visualization-viewer" class="visualization-viewer hidden">
    <button
      id="visualization-close"
      class="visualization-close"
      type="button"
      aria-label="Close">
      &times;
    </button>

    <div class="visualization-viewer-content">

      <div class="visualization-image-container">
        <img
          id="visualization-viewer-image"
          src=""
          alt="">
      </div>

      <div class="visualization-information">
        <h2 id="visualization-viewer-title"></h2>
        <p id="visualization-viewer-description"></p>
      </div>

    </div>
  </div>

</div>
```
